content: {"episode_id":"ep-05056","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, for which the payer states required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered. The clinical indication note documents a patient presenting with a history of recurrent syncope and palpitations, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other cardiac arrhythmias, consistent with the submitted diagnosis codes I49.9, I48.91, and R55. Per the note, mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances and correlate symptoms with electrocardiographic findings over an extended monitoring period. This appeal is submitted with that supporting clinical documentation as the payer letter invites, 34 days after service and within the 146 days remaining to the filing deadline."}
